items.title: Wardrobe delivery and assembly
items.quote: Wir liefern und montieren ihn am Samstag, 12.12.2026; unser Team ist ab 08:00 Uhr bei Ihnen und braucht etwa drei Stunden.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date and time for the delivery appointment: Saturday, 12.12.2026, team arriving from 08:00. No counting or shifting rule applies to a stated appointment date.

items.title: Call to reschedule delivery if date does not suit
items.quote: Passt Ihnen der Tag nicht, rufen Sie uns spätestens drei Werktage vorher an.
items.computation: The delivery appointment is Saturday 12.12.2026. 'Spätestens drei Werktage vorher' means the call must be made at least 3 Werktage (Mon-Sat, excluding public holidays) before that day, counting backwards and not counting the appointment day itself. Counting back 3 Werktage from 2026-12-12 in NRW (no holidays skipped) lands on Wednesday 2026-12-09. So the latest day to call is 2026-12-09.

warnings: This is a company delivery notice, not an authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery or appeal rules apply; dates are as printed in the letter.

The 'at least 3 Werktage before' call deadline is a practical instruction from the company, not a legal deadline with fixed counting rules, so the exact calculation (whether the appointment day itself is excluded) could not be independently verified against the sender's own practice.
